answer: Locks are entered in wharf, expire in violet, and gale lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 27 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 45 aliases thus needs 163 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4468 identities would post 1088 proofs and burn roughly 61 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
